title: The Gloaming Road — original miniature consort
palette: D Dorian; minor pentachord motif; open fifths and added seconds; no soundtrack transcription

title.description: A lamp in the eastern window: invitation, answering reed, open fifth return.

meadow.description: Roadside consort: eight varied phrases, plucked walking figures, middle countervoice, long rests.

forest.description: Under the black leaves: lowered reed, separated organ breaths, distant high harmonics.

duel.description: Iron at the ford: fractured five-note calls, measured frame drum, retreating half-phrases.

royal.description: The crown's oath: antiphonal reeds, ceremonial organ, final rising answer.

rescue.description: A hand in the dawn: one rising answer, a suspended second, then a quiet D–A resolution.
